scope: Eight text-geometry labels only; no implementation, builds, CI, Work tasks, publication, or revisions to unrelated accepted labels.

fresh_network_check.outcome: Cache miss / failed fetch; no denial was reported. No bytes or fresh attestation obtained; local previously pinned full snapshots were used with matching recomputed hashes.

coverage_limitations: No claim that the entire available translation corpus, dictionary literature, or current web was exhaustively searched.
No exact primary translation of all source English labels as complete phrases was established. Exact lexical records, adapted function-label forms, and composed phrases are explicitly distinguished.
An empty or fuzzy record is not used as positive translation evidence. Nonfuzzy records can still contain errors.
AOSP Settings font/display-size and left/right records were inspected but not used as positive alignment evidence; those directions can refer to unrelated audio/device controls.
No native speaker, independent reviewer, or runtime validation is included. All eight author_status values remain review.
exclusions: No accepted text-direction, image-motion, object alignment, or whole-canvas-centering substitution.
Object bottom-alignment help has apparent source-target drift and is retained only as an exclusion example.
Spelling variants are disclosed, not silently conflated.
